reporting-org.narrative: King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Centre

title.narrative: General Volunteer Project for Psychosocial Support

description.narrative: Provide specialized psychological services: organize training courses to strengthen psychological skills. Support beneficiaries: provide individual and group sessions for necessary psychological support. Encourage volunteer work: engage volunteers in providing psychological services and expanding the scope of support. Raise awareness: promote awareness of the importance of mental health and ways of coping with psychological challenges.

Psychosocial support through specialized training courses in the psychological field, and providing psychological counseling to individuals most in need, especially beneficiaries of the prosthetic limb fitting program.
